The pattern was found via a monitoring alert for device ring `C08972-K2` after an analyst requested a review.

sar.narrative: Customer C08972, holder of card C08972-K2, is the subject of this report due to suspicious online activity. Between 2016-11-29 17:50 and 2016-11-29 17:50, one transaction totaling $170.37 (3497753) was conducted on the card online from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' behind an anonymous proxy. The identity record marks this device as new for the account, and this specific handset profile never appears in the card's prior history. The same device profile was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window around the alert, with all 28 behind an anonymous or hidden proxy and flagged as new devices, indicating a common actor. Four closed cases on cards using this profile were confirmed fraud and recorded as an undocumented pattern. Furthermore, 8 of the 8 most similar closed cases, including CC-2985, CC-2649, CC-3035, and CC-2971, were confirmed fraud. The transaction amount of $170.37 is within the card's usual range, having a median of $100.06 and a 95th percentile of $446.09, and the case-memory model score was 0.013 with a bank risk score of 0.13. In response to this activity, the bank has executed automatic actions to create a case, monitor connected cards, and escalate to an analyst, while awaiting human approval for blocking card C08972-K2 and filing this report.
